page.overview:
Who is Car V. Mudflap?

It is a grey cylinder with orange stripes, with two eyes, a mouth, and a bushy mustache with a pair of matching bushy eyebrows. It has a grey cap on top, dark grey arms with light grey claws, and a grey stand. It has dark grey legs with pairs of orange wheels for feet.
